injuries.name: Nick Bjugstad
injuries.note: Bjugstad is recovering from a torn pectoral muscle which required surgery. The 34-year-old is expected to be sidelined until January at a minimum, so this move doesn't change his timeline. Should further injuries arise, the Devils will have a bit more cap flexibility.

injuries.name: Seamus Casey
injuries.note: Casey figures to miss at least 19 more games if he is on the short end of his recovery timeline. While it's certainly a blow that will stretch the Devils' defensive depth, Casey would likely have served as a healthy scratch more often than not. Once given the all-clear, the 22-year-old Florida native could be headed to the minors in order to get his legs back under him.

injuries.name: Thatcher Demko
injuries.note: Demko missed the second half of the 2025-26 season after undergoing hip surgery in January, and he was officially placed on injured reserve last week. He doesn't yet have a clear timetable for when he'll be back in action, but Sedin said that Demko is "taking steps every day" in his recovery process. While Demko is sidelined, Kevin Lankinen and Leevi Merilainen should compete for starts in the Canucks' crease.

injuries.name: Nick Bjugstad
injuries.note: Pectoral: The New Jersey Devils placed F Nick Bjugstad on long-term injured reserve on Friday (Oct. 9).

injuries.name: Connor Brown
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Devils said on Thursday (Oct. 8) that Brown will remain out this weekend and plans to return next week.

injuries.name: Seamus Casey
injuries.note: Knee: The New Jersey Devils said on Friday (Oct. 2) that Casey will miss 8-10 weeks after undergoing knee surgery.

injuries.name: Filip Chytil
injuries.note: Shoulder: The Vancouver Canucks placed F Filip Chytil on injured reserve on Friday (Sept. 25).

injuries.name: Thatcher Demko
injuries.note: Hip: The Canucks placed Demko on injured reserve and hopeful he will be ready to return before Christmas, per Kevin Woodley of NHL.com.
